description: This file defines functions to interact with the backend API for fetching organization (tenant) data. It includes a single primary function 'listOrganizations' that retrieves and normalizes a list of organizations, including handling various data formats and key variants.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches the list of organizations (tenants) for the current user, normalizes different data formats, sorts the results by name and id, and returns an array of organization objects with 'id' and 'name' properties.
